## Extra requirements for this version of the task

- File names and titles may contain spaces and non-ASCII characters (see `data/posts/`). Sort file names with Python's default string order, and print them exactly as they are, also in the JSON output.
- Posts can start with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM).
- A's fixture under `fixtures/` holds a base64-encoded sample post that your tests can use.
